_comment: The URL should be opened during initialization. The instruction can simply say, “Increase the page zoom level to 150%.” The evaluator can skip checking the URL, since opening it isn’t the main point of this task.
instruction: Open Google Chrome and navigate to https://www.digital.nsw.gov.au/delivery/accessibility-and-inclusivity-toolkit. Increase the page zoom level to 150% and leave the webpage open.
gt_steps: Wait for the webpage to load.
Increase the page zoom level to 150%.
Leave the webpage open with the zoom indicator showing 150%.
